privateVars.name: tvRepository
privateVars.description: Repository for upserting TV show data

privateVars.name: jobQueue
privateVars.description: RxJS Subject that acts as the job queue for TVDB sync operations

privateVars.name: processing
privateVars.description: Set of TVDB IDs currently being processed to avoid duplicate jobs

functions.name: onModuleInit
functions.description: NestJS lifecycle hook that starts processing the job queue on module initialization

functions.name: addJob
functions.description: Adds a TVDB ID to the job queue for syncing. Skips if the ID is already being processed.

functions.name: processQueue
functions.description: Sets up an RxJS pipeline that processes queued jobs with concurrency of 3. Each job calls syncTvFromTvdb and handles errors gracefully.

functions.name: syncTvFromTvdb
functions.description: Fetches full TV show data from TheTVDB and upserts it into the repository

functions.name: fetchFromTvdb
functions.description: Fetches complete TV show data from TheTVDB API including series details, translations, episodes, seasons, artworks, cast, companies, and trailers. Returns null if the API call fails.
